messages:
priya: heads up — noticed a small but persistent provisional-only delta on us-east streaming routes during last night's canary (model-swap + fallback).
caleb: how small? any customer impact?
priya: roughly 600 tokens across 6 sessions, persisted ~15m before auto-eviction. no known bill impact yet but noisy on the billing alerts.
omar: can you paste the logs / query that found it?
priya: query i ran (clickhouse):
```
select session, sum(if(event='provisional_alloc', tokens,0)) as p, sum(if(event='confirmed_write', tokens,0)) as c
from tokens_events
where event_time >= now() - interval '2 hour' and route='us-east'
group by session
having p > c
order by p desc
limit 20
```
priya: and a representative log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-25T23:41:02Z] session=abc-321 event=handoff.start provisional=100 handoff_id=H-52 model_swap=stable->fast
[2026-03-25T23:41:03Z] session=abc-321 event=stream.chunk truncated=true
[2026-03-25T23:41:04Z] session=abc-321 event=client.retry new_session=abc-321.r1
[2026-03-25T23:41:05Z] session=abc-321.r1 event=handoff.start provisional=100 handoff_id=H-52.1
# no handoff.finish for H-52 or H-52.1, no confirmed_write emitted until ~10m later by gc/eviction path
```
leah: sounds like classic replay + handoff ambiguity. both old and new handoff ids allocate provisional and neither gets confirmed because the replay never completes handshake.
caleb: are clients sending any provenance headers we can use to dedupe? we recently added x-origin-session in some SDKs but not universally.
omar: router-side solution would be more robust. simple idea: when handoff.start sees a recent handoff id with overlapping prefix hash within X seconds, treat as replay and do not allocate a second provisional; instead extend TTL on the first provisional. requires router to compute prefix hash cheaply.
leah: downside: possible false dedupe if legitimate parallel streams. need a conservative window and require matching provenance or same client-ip + similar user-agent.
priya: for observability: suggest adding tokens.provisional_delta gauge and a panel per-route with last 1h sparkline + link to sample traces (Console). ops keep paging without quick context.
console-ui: we can add a "provisional delta" column to Billing -> Routes and a click-through to the top 5 affected sessions. i'll open a small PR.
caleb: short-term mitigation: run a reconciliation sweep that finds provisional rows > TTL with a later confirmed_write for same customer/prefix, mark reconciled and emit audit event. make sweep per-customer and idempotent.
omar: +1. also router should emit a reconciliation hint when it performs forced confirmed_write on fallback so sweep can more efficiently reconcile.
priya: can we add a telemetry label `provisional_phase={started,confirmed,orphaned}` on tokens.* metrics? that'd make dashboarding straightforward.
telemetry-bot: queued change: telemetry schema PR draft will add tokens.provisional_phase and tokens.provisional_delta. CI run scheduled.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-05 opened: "Provisional delta during canary model-swap"
caleb: rollout plan: (1) add provisional_delta panel + alert (fires if delta > 500 tokens for > 5m), (2) run one-off sweep on canary customer cohort tonight, (3) deploy router conservative-replay-dedupe on us-east canary for 30m, monitor, then widen.
leah: on the router patch, prefer conservative default: 8s dedupe window, require either x-origin-session or client-ip+ua match. document the fallback behavior in internal API.
omar: i'll draft the router PR and include a feature flag `router.replay_dedupe` so we can rollback quickly.
priya: i'll author the sweep job (billing service) and add tokens.sweep.{reconciled_count,error_count} metrics.
caleb: console-ui, please gate the new column behind an experimental flag so we can roll internal-first.
console-ui: noted, PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pulls/219 — adds provisional delta column + trace links behind flag.
telemetry-bot: telemetry PR #67 created: will run integration tests.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window on canary tonight 01:00 UTC for sweep + router canary.
priya: thanks everyone. i'll post results and sample before/after numbers to the incident and follow up with a short blameless postmortem if it persists.
